node.n1_safehouse.title: Nḓu ya vhuthogwa (Room 404)
node.n1_safehouse.desc: Fhathi ya fhasi ya vhuraru yo swifhalaho nṱha ha vhuvhambadzi ha zwiambaro. Neon i tshi khou phazhima, maphepha a dockets, na jenareitha ya tshipentshela.
node.n2_taxi_rank.title: Queen Street Taxi Rank
node.n2_taxi_rank.desc: Tshipiringi tsha Toyota Quantums dzo imaho, jenareitha dzi tshi khou ruma, na munukho wa shisanyama yo gadziwaho.
node.n3_central_precinct.title: Durban Central Police Station
node.n3_central_precinct.desc: Phasheji dzo ḓalaho mitshelo ya fluorescent i tshi khou phazhima, dzhele dzo valwaho, na vhuimo ha ndaulo ha TRT ha Brigadier Mokoena.
node.n4_city_hall.title: City Hall Tender Office
node.n4_city_hall.desc: Makhulwane a marabole a tshi khou dzumba vhufhura ha murahu, zwikontiraka zwa vhufhura, na memora ya tender yo tatulwaho.
node.n5_cyber_pawn.title: Point Road Cyber-Pawn
node.n5_cyber_pawn.desc: Khaunthara ya neon i tshi rengisa SIM cards dzo kopiwa, radio decoders dza vhuswole, na hardware i sa tevhelelei.
node.n6_pier2_port.title: Pier 2 Container Terminal
node.n6_pier2_port.desc: Khrane dzi tshi khou vhonala kha mume. Berth 14 i langa mathenkhi a mishonga i sa ṱalusiwaho.
node.n7_archive_basement.title: Old Municipal Archive Basement
node.n7_archive_basement.desc: Dzimbado dza fhasi ha mavu dzo ḓalaho maḓi dzo vhulungaho rekodo dza masipala dza miṅwaha minzhi na vhuṱanzi ha Hawks vho bviswaho.
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.title: The Ridge Penthouses
node.n8_ridge_penthouses.desc: Tshiṱara tsha girasi na tsimbi tshi tshi sedza lwanzhe lwa Indian Ocean. Tsho lindwa nga maswole a vhuṱala a re na akhaunthu dza nnda ha shango.
node.n9_township_depot.title: Northern Township Depot
node.n9_township_depot.desc: Zwitolo zwa tsimbi zwo ḓalaho mathenkhi a maḓi a masipala o tswiwaho, u tswiwa ha muvhuso, na vhalindi vho ṱuledzwaho nga zwibalesa.
node.n10_high_court.title: Durban High Court Chambers
node.n10_high_court.desc: Khoro ya mulayo ya kholoni ya thanda na tsimbi he ha hanzhedzwa subpoena dza vhufhura ha dzikarteli.
node.n11_citrus_estate.title: Hydroponic Citrus Estate
node.n11_citrus_estate.desc: Tshipida tsha vhulimi tsho vhofhaho tshi tshi dzumba riyakthara dza mishonga ya fhasi ha mavu na vhufulo ha zwithu zwa u ita mishonga.
node.n12_cargo_apron.title: King Shaka Cargo Apron
node.n12_cargo_apron.desc: Hangar 7 he Gulfstream ZS-900 na difege dza thundu dza vhuima dza tshi khou fhambana na milayo ya vhuṱanzi ya Afrika Tshipembe.

slot.act_audit_docket.title: U sedza Docket #409
slot.act_audit_docket.desc: Vhambedza invoyisi dza tanka dzo tshinyalaho na rejisitara ya masipala.
slot.act_audit_docket.clean: Wo tevhela mbadelo u swika kha Zululand Aqua-Logistics na Pier 2.
slot.act_audit_docket.compromised: U sedza nga maanda fhasi ha thambo ya inverter yo tshinyalaho zwo bveledza dzina la mu-direkthara wa tshifhinganyana.
slot.act_audit_docket.failure: Khoude dza ledgere ndi tshipiringi tsha zwithu zwi si na mvelelo. Thohoyani ha khou rwa.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.title: U awela na u fhodza Nandi
slot.act_rest_safehouse.desc: Vhuya na vhuimo ha mbilu. Renga gaza ya vhulwadze u itela u imisa tshifhinga tsha vhulwadze ha Nandi.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.clean: Wo sukula mbande dzawe wa awela. Nandi o thoma u fhodza.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.compromised: U awela ho dzhenelelwa nga siren dza mapholisa dzo tshi khou pfala Queen Street.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.failure: U edela ho tshinyalaho ho dalaho miloro ya vhuvhi nga ha zwigwada zwa Mokoena zwa TRT.
slot.act_call_maharaj.title: Dzhenisa Dr. Maharaj (Dokotela wa vhuvhili)
slot.act_call_maharaj.desc: Dzhenisa dokotela wa vhuvhili u itela u bvisa tshipululu na u vhumba Nandi.
slot.act_call_maharaj.clean: Dr. Maharaj o bvisa tshipululu nga vhukoni. Nandi u khou fhola.
slot.act_call_maharaj.compromised: U vhiwa ho vha ho khakha fhasi ha mboni dza thotshi, fhedzi vhutshilo ha Nandi ho vhumba.
slot.act_call_maharaj.failure: Dr. Maharaj o ofhiswa nga vhan ya mapholisa nnda, a sia fhedzi mishonga ya vhulwadze.
slot.act_rank_muscle.title: U thivhela vha-shumisi vha nnda
slot.act_rank_muscle.desc: Tshikinya vha-shumisi vha nnda vha Umgeni corridor u itela Bra Bheki.
slot.act_rank_muscle.clean: Vhavhili vha taxi vho badela vha songo bvisa zwigidi. Bra Bheki o tenda nga u ṱhonifha.
slot.act_rank_muscle.compromised: Wrentshi yo u rwa kha phephe ya pfudzi, fhedzi wo bva na tshelede.
slot.act_rank_muscle.failure: Zwigidi zwo rwiwa tsini na vhukati ha rank. Siren dza mapholisa dza Metro dzo lila kule.
slot.act_taxi_intel.title: Shumisa vhavhili vha taxi
slot.act_taxi_intel.desc: Badela vha-rangi vha rank u tevhela bakkie dza TRT na u thivhela nndila.
slot.act_taxi_intel.clean: Vhavhili vha taxi vho dadzisa radio nga nndila dza Mokoena dza vhulindi.
slot.act_taxi_intel.compromised: Mafhungo o phadalalaho a tshi bva kha vhavhili vhe vha vhona hafu ya vhathu.
slot.act_taxi_intel.failure: Wo badela mafhungo a si na mvelelo a tshi bva kha vha-nwa-halwa.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.title: Rula mu-shumisi wa vhuṱanzi
slot.act_bribe_clerk.desc: Netshedza mu-shumisi wa mapholisa tshelede u itela u wana mivhigo ya N2 heist.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.clean: Mu-shumisi o u netshedza mivhigo ya vhuṱanzi kha thebulu ya khentini.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.compromised: Wo wana mivhigo ya hafu musi vha-langi vha tshi khou fhira.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.failure: Mu-shumisi o dzhia tshelede yawe a u vhiga kha sergenti wa Mokoena.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.title: Dzhenela ofisini ya Mokoena
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.desc: Vhudza mulanguli wau wa kale nga ha uri ndi ngani Nandi e kha lisi ya BOLO.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.clean: Mokoena o tenda mafhungo au a vhu-vhemu a u netshedza R3,000 u itela Docket #409.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.compromised: Mokoena o u sedza nga maanda kha thebulu yawe. Wo wana awara dza 24.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.failure: Mokoena o vhona vhuvhili hau. Mapholisa a TRT o u bvisa nga zwigidi.
slot.act_audit_tenders.title: Dzhenela rejisitara ya masipala
slot.act_audit_tenders.desc: Dzhia vhuimo ha mu-sedzi u itela u tevhela dzi-akhaundi dza Zululand Aqua-Logistics.
slot.act_audit_tenders.clean: Wo bvisa khophi dzo sainiwaho dza Ma-Sibi dza vhu-vhemu ha tanka.
slot.act_audit_tenders.compromised: Vha-lindi vho vha vha tshi khou u fara, fhedzi wo balangana na risiti dza ndeme.
slot.act_audit_tenders.failure: Alamu dzo lila kha phuloro ya vhu-ina. Wo balangana u si na tshithu.
slot.act_masibi_deal.title: Itani vhukonani na mu-languli wa Ma-Sibi
slot.act_masibi_deal.desc: Netshedza u fhedza ledgere ya mu-sedzi u itela u wana tsireledzo ya City Hall.
slot.act_masibi_deal.clean: Mu-languli wa Ma-Sibi o u rumela R5,000 na u u vulela nndila ya gridi ya masipala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.compromised: Mu-languli o tenda vhukonani ha tshifhinganyana, a vula gridi ya masipala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.failure: Vha-lindi vha masipala vho u pandela nnda na u vhiga Central Precinct.
slot.act_crack_phone.title: Tshinya founu ya mu-sedzi
slot.act_crack_phone.desc: Tshinya vhu-vhemu ha founu ya mu-sedzi o faho.
slot.act_crack_phone.clean: Sparks o tshinya vhu-vhemu. Mvumo dza Pier 2 dzo thoma u da.
slot.act_crack_phone.compromised: Tsireledzo yo thoma u phumula zwithu, fhedzi Sparks o imisa firewall.
slot.act_crack_phone.failure: Tsireledzo yo vhiga Abasanta cyber-cleaners musi Sparks a sa athu u bvisa thambo.
slot.act_clone_transponder.title: U khophiwa ha mafhungo a radio a SAPS
slot.act_clone_transponder.desc: Vhumbani tshishumiswa tsha u thivhela radio u itela u thetshelesa TRT na u fhira zwikhwathavhelo zwa SAPS.
slot.act_clone_transponder.clean: Wo fara tshishumiswa tsho khophiwaho tsha SAPS—zwino u khou kona u thetshelesa na u fhira zwikhwathavhelo zwoṱhe nga tshifhinga tsha zwino.
slot.act_clone_transponder.compromised: Tshishumiswa tsha radio tsha u thivhela tshi khou shuma nga nḓila ine wa nga fhira ngayo zwikhwathavhelo zwa mapholisa.
slot.act_clone_transponder.failure: Wo fhisa phanela ya u solda nahone wo xelelwa nga R500 ya zwitshipi zwa u vhumbela.
slot.act_recon_berth14.title: U sedzulusa Berth 14 Container Drop
slot.act_recon_berth14.desc: Fhatani zwifanyiso zwa migomo ya mishonga ine ya khou takulwa u ya kha mathenkhi a masipala.
slot.act_recon_berth14.clean: Zwifanyiso zwo pfalaho zwa Mokoena a tshi khou thetshelana na mulanguli wa Berth 14 wa Zuko.
slot.act_recon_berth14.compromised: Vhalindi vha mawathe vho vhona tshedza tsha thotshi yau; wo shavhela kha zwikwama zwa khonthena.
slot.act_recon_berth14.failure: Vha-khoro vha cartel vho u kumedza murahu ha forklift; wo shavha nga vhukono u bva getheni.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.title: [FINALE] Tanganani na Convoy ya Berth 14
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.desc: Tanganani na u takulwa ha mathenkhi vhukati ha vhusiku u itela u vhea vhuvhindi kana u ita thendelano na Kingpin ngei The Glass House.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.clean: Wo dzula nṱha ha Berth 14 musi mathenkhi a madi a masipala a tshi swika tsini na crane ya Zuko.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.compromi: Wo fhira gethe la mukhuvha nga fhasi ha mvula ine ya khou na musi injini dza convoy dzi tshi thoma u rila.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.failure: Mmbwa dza vhalindi vha port dzo u kombetshedza u humela murahu; tshifhinga tsha u rumela tsho no swika.
slot.act_handover_dockets.title: Vhudzani Colonel van der Merwe
slot.act_handover_dockets.desc: Kumedzani khophi dzo khwathiswaho dza Docket #409 kha vha-ongolosi vha Hawks vha vhupfumedzi.
slot.act_handover_dockets.clean: Van der Merwe o valela fhelelo kha safe. Vha Hawks vha khou vhula dodoshi ya mulayo.
slot.act_handover_dockets.compromised: Van der Merwe o u sevha uri Mokoena u na vhathu vhawe vha re ngomu kha vhurekhodo ha Hawks.
slot.act_handover_dockets.failure: Van der Merwe u khou ita raid; wo sia zwidivhadzo kha sergenti wa ofisini ane a khou ofha.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.ti: [FINALE] Thomiwa u phadaladza mafhungo a Lushaka na u tsireledza mboni
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.de: Valani dziphulu dza vhurekhodo nahone u rumela vhuṱanzi ha Berth 14 kha The Daily Veld u itela u thoma Act 1 Climax.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.cl: Uplink ya Van der Merwe yo vhofhelela kha The Daily Veld musi vhusiku vhu tshi swika Berth 14.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.co: Uplink yo dzula naho ho vha na vha-thivheli vha TRT nnda ha khothe ya masitirata.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.fa: Tshithu tsho thivhela u rumela—tshifhinga tsha vhusiku Berth 14 tsho no swika.
clock.mokoena_sweep.desc: Mapholisa a TRT a khou ṱoḓa Constable Nandi ngei CBD.
clock.nandi_condition.desc: U ṱoḓa u fhodiwa ha vhulwadze vhu re kule na vhurekhodo vha vhushaka phanḓa ha musi vhulwadze vhu tshi phadalala.
clock.precinct_heat.desc: Vha-vhudzi vha SAPS na CCTV vha khou tevhelela vhufhambani hau.
clock.audit_docket_409.desc: Teveleleni inwoisi dza R400m dza mathenkhi a madi u ya kha khamphani ya vhufhura.
clock.crack_auditor_phone.desc: Fhambanani na vhurekhodo ha biometric ngei Golden Dragon Cyber-Pawn.
clock.berth_14_countdown.desc: Maduvha ane a sala u swika musi thundu ya Zuko i tshi bva Pier 2 (Act 1 Climax).
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.title: Tshedza tsha Buluu ngei Alley
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.speaker: Sergeant Dlamini
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Zwienda zwa nndwa zwi khou rila kha stairwell ya Mercury Arcade. Nga fhasi ha blinds, Volkswagen Golf GTI tharu na Nyala dzo vala mitalo yoṱhe ya tshitara.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Tshithu tsha pfuti tshi khou rwa gethe la tshipi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Vhulani gethe kana ri a li thuthuwedza! Brigadier Mokoena u ṱoḓa docket yawe!"
choice.choice_roof_escape.label: Shavhelani nṱha ha dzinthanga dza Arcade
choice.choice_roof_escape.desc: Fhani Nandi na docket, kwelani nga skylight, nahone ni wela kha taxi rank alley.
choice.choice_roof_escape.log: Wo shavha nṱha ha tshipi tsho rumbaho nga mvula. TRT yo thuthuwedza nḓu i si na muthu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.label: Kumedzani envelope ya brown nga zwikwama (R1,200)
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.desc: Sergeant Dlamini u na zwi-kolodo zwa vhurei ngei Greyville. Mu badeleni uri a ambe uri nḓu yo vha i si na muthu.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.log: Dlamini o vhona tshelede, a amba kha radio uri mafhungo o vha a si a ngoho, nahone a humisa tshigwada tshawe.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.label: Kumedzani mapepala a vhufhura nahone ni rwiwe
choice.choice_burn_decoy.desc: Vhulani mapepala a ngoho nga fhasi ha phuloro nahone ni tambule nga u rwiwa ha TRT.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.log: Dlamini o u sia wo rwiwa nṱha ha phuloro, a tshi khou isa mapepala a vhufhura Central Precinct.
event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Septic Shock
event.evt_nandi_critical.speaker: Constable Nandi
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: Nandi u khou tetemela nga maṱozi fhasi ha nguvho yo ḓalaho biko. Mbonzhe ya khulu ya bara kha mbambo dzawe yo no vha ya lutombo lwo swifhalaho lwa vhuhali, nahone u khou dzhena na u bva kha vhuḓipfi.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Arali na mu isa Addington kana Sibadela tsha Inkosi Albert Luthuli, rejisitara ya vhathu vho thuntshwaho i ḓo ḓivhadza Brigadier Mokoena nga fhasi ha miṅwethe ya furaru.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.label: Badelani Dokotela Maharaj kha vhuaro ha tshihaḓu (R1,500)
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.desc: Vhidzani dokotela wa vhuaro a siho kha maṅwalo a re na tshishumiswa tsha u fhisa mbonzhe na mishonga ya IV ya lithuthuvha.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.log: Dokotela Maharaj u bvisa zwipiḓa zwa musuku zwa khulu nahone a lulamisa Nandi musi ḽi sa athu tsha.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.label: Vhidzani Colonel van der Merwe u wana madokotela a nndu yo tsireledzeaho
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.desc: Zwi ṱoḓa u fhulufhedzea kha Hawks. Kumedzani Nandi kha tshigwada tsha mishumo ya Old Archive u itela dzilafho ḽa tshiphiri.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.log: Van der Merwe u humbela Nandi nga tshiphiri nga veni ya milenzhe a mu isa kiliniki ya kule yo tsireledzeaho.
choice.choice_public_hospital.label: Mu laṱeni Wadini ya Vhauvhi ya Muvhuso nahone ni shavhe
choice.choice_public_hospital.desc: Zwi tshidza vhutshilo hawe mahala, fhedzi Mokoena u mbo ḓi sala vhutshilo hanu murahu nga u ṱavhanya.
choice.choice_public_hospital.log: Madokotela vha tshidza Nandi, fhedzi maofisiri a TRT a tanga wadi ya vhauvhi nga fhasi ha awara.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: U Valwa ha Masia nga Operation Shanela
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.speaker: Vhurumelwa ha Mapholisa a Metro
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.role: Gondo-vuleli ḽo ṱanganelwaho ḽa SAPS / Metro
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Dzitshikona dzi khou pfala vhukati ha zwihaṱo zwilapfu. Tshedza tshihulwane na dzikhounu dza luvhela zwi khou vala maraho mahulwane a CBD musi SAPS na Metro Police vha tshi khou vhea mutanganyi muhulwane wa u imisa na u secha.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Kombi iṅwe na iṅwe, thuthuthu ya vhurumelwa, na muthu muṅwe na muṅwe a tshimbilaho nga milenzhe vha khou sechwa u sedza zwigidi zwi siho enghwaloni na dziṅwalo dzo tswiwaho dza milandu.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.label: Namani Kombi ya VIP ya Bra Bheki kha gogo
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.desc: Shumisani vhuimo hanu ha Street Syndicate u fhira mutanganyi kha goloi ya mbumbano i sa kwamiwiho.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.log: Mapholisa a Metro a vheledza Quantum ya Bra Bheki yo swifhadzwaho mafulo a songo sedza maṅwalo a vhune.
choice.choice_spot_fine.label: Badelani Masheleni a "Tshinwelo tshi Rokolaho" hafhano Gondoni (R600)
choice.choice_spot_fine.desc: Petenyani notsi tharu dza R200 nga ngomu ha laisentsi yaṋu ya u reila nahone ni kokodzele ṱhoho fhasi.
choice.choice_spot_fine.log: Lifhorisa ḽi panga masheleni muhomboni, ḽa khokhona ṱhanga yaṋu, nahone ḽa ni vhidzela u fhira vhukati ha dzikhounu.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.label: Lindelani zwi fhire ngomu ha Mikwevho ya Maḓi a Mvula
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.desc: Fhedzani dziawara ni tshi khou buba maḓini a swikaho zwikunwani fhasi ha N2 u swikela vha gondo-vuleli vha tshi paka vha ṱuwa.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.log: Ni bvela nnda no ṋwala nahone no neta nga matsheloni, fhedzi maṱala aṋu o no dzima.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: Phaiphi ya Dithangi dza Maḓi
event.evt_docket_decoded.location: Fulethi ya Mercury Arcade • Bodo ya Vhuṱanzi
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: Ni vhea masiada o ḓalaho malofha a Docket #409 kha ṱafula ḽaṋu fhasi ha luvhone lwa inivhetha. Mbalo dzi thoma u pfesesea zwino.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" yo badelisa Holo ya Ḓorobo R400 miḽiyoni u isa maḓi a shango kha dziḽokishi dzo omaho dza devhula. Fhedzi maṅwalo a GPS a sumbedza uri dithangi idzo dza masipala a dzo ngo vhuya dza ya dziḽokishini—dzo reila u bva tshoṱhe Pier 2 Cold Storage dza ya zwifhatoni zwa zwiimiswa zwa mabindu nnda ha ḓorobo, dzo tsireledzwa nga dzigoloi dza TRT dza Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Khanselara Ma-Sibi ha khou sokou tswa masheleni a maḓi fhedzi. Dithangi dzawe dza masipala dzi khou hwala zwibuluki zwa khemikhala zwi re maḓi zwa dzilabu khulwane dza tikiti ya methamphetamine ya Zuko Ndlovu.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.label: Kokotelani Holo ya Ḓorobo na Pier 2 Mmapani
choice.choice_unlock_leads.desc: Zwi vula City Hall Annex (N4) na Pier 2 Cold Storage (N6) u itela u ṱoḓisisa zwi songo dzumbamaho kana u vutshela nga zwa vhumbulu.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.log: Mvelaphande: City Hall Annex na Pier 2 Cold Storage zwino zwo vulea kha mmapa waṋu wa tshiṱiriki.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Guranḓingo ya Ipfi u bva Berth 14
event.evt_phone_decrypted.location: Golden Dragon Cyber-Pawn • Buthu ya Murahu
event.evt_phone_decrypted.speaker: Sparks
event.evt_phone_decrypted.role: Muphuphuledzi wa Zwiga na Khonzero dza Tshiphiri
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: Sparks u femela nnda gogo ḽa vheiphi musi lutingo lwa muodithi o lovhaho lu tshi khou pwashelwa phasiwede yalwo ya zwikunwe. Ngomu ha fulodara yo dzumbamaho hu na theiphi ya ipfi yo tsireledzwaho na mutevhe wa zwiphuthelwa zwa vhusiku ha ṋamusi.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Kha rekodo iyo, ipfi ḽo khwaṱhaho ḽa Brigadier Mokoena ḽi pfala zwavhuḓi: "Kulumaganyani webriji ya N2 nga vhusikukati. Khontheinara ya Zuko i wela kha Berth 14, nahone muthu muṅwe na muṅwe wa Hawks ane a nunkhidza henefho u ḓo swikiswa mugodini a gonyelwa fhasi."
choice.choice_take_manifest.label: Kopani Manifesiti ya Berth 14 na Vhudavhidzani ha Hawks
choice.choice_take_manifest.desc: Zwi vula Bazementi ya Old Archive (N7) nahone zwi ni ṋea maanḓa a u fara Mokoena na Zuko nga mutsinga.
choice.choice_take_manifest.log: Ni panga dilaivi yo kopololwaho muhomboni. Bazementi ya vhuvhulungelo ya Colonel van der Merwe zwino i a swikelelea.
event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Vhusikukati kha Berth 14: Muṅalo wa u Ghedzisela
event.evt_climax_berth14.location: Themini ya Dzikhontheinara ya Pier 2 • 11:55 PM
event.evt_climax_berth14.speaker: Vhulanguli ha Boṱo na Vhurumelwa ha Zwivhanda
event.evt_climax_berth14.role: Tsheo ya Magumo ya Tshipiḓa tsha 1
event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Mvula i khou rotha nga lurumbu lwa Khenele ya Boṱo ya Natal musi mitshini mihulwane ya gantry ya Pier 2 i tshi khou vhonala vhukati ha khuli. Fhasi ha Berth 14, dithangi tharu dza maḓi dza masipala dzo ima lwa u sokou linda tsini na dzikhontheinara dzo vhulungwaho dza zwilili dza Zuko Ndlovu, dzo tanganyedzwa nga dzi-Nyala dza TRT dza Brigadier Mokoena dzi re na tshedza tsha lutombo.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Tshifhinga tshaṋu tsho fhela. Hu ṅwe na ṅwe arali no swika henefha ni na magwada a masheleni o sengululwaho, theiphi dzo dzumbamaho dza muodithi, kana fhedzi maanḓa a tshiṱiratarata, ni na tshibuli tshithihi fhedzi tsha u lwa musi gogo ḽi sa athu thoma u bva ḽi tshi livha badani khulwane ya N2.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.label: [GWAḒO ḼA VHARENGISI] Sumedzani Izinkabi dza Bra Bheki nahone ni Thuntshise Gogo ḽoṱhe nga Mulilo
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.desc: Tusa nndwa ya vhukati ha vhupo ha Queen Street Syndicate na zwigwada zwa TRT zwa Mokoena, u fhise zwikwama zwa khemikhala, nahone u thube R450,000 ya tshelete ya khathale.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.log: Tshiphiri tsha thambula tshi tshi fhisa migomo ya Pier 2 musi u tshi thuthuwedza goloi ya ndaulo nahone wa nyamalala vhusikuni na tshelete ya khathale.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.label: [NDILA YA MUVHULI WA TSHIPHIRI] Wanulusa Dosiya kha The Daily Veld & Hawks
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.desc: Phadadzani rekhodo ya madi na rekhodo ya u rekhoda zwiambiso zwa Mokoena shangoni lothe musi Colonel van der Merwe a tshi bvisa Constable Nandi u mu isa vhudzuloni ha tsireledzo ya vhutanzi.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.log: Nga 06:00 AM, maipfi a Brigadier Mokoena a khou pfala kha zwiteshi zwoṱhe zwa radio Afurika Tshipembe nahone Treasury yo thivhela tenda ya R400m ya Ma-Sibi.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.label: [NDILA YA KHINGPIN] Kwela u ya The Glass House & U humbela 20% ya Phayipulaini
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.desc: Sangana na Zuko Ndlovu, Muofisiri Muhulwane wa Ma-Sibi, na Brigadier Mokoena ntha ha zwikwama zwa mabele. U fhise Docket #409 iwe mune u itela u humiselwa mushumoni na u vha mufhateli wa sindikate.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.log: U lahlela Docket #409 kha tshivhaso tsha The Glass House. U kwasulwa ha u go bviswa, nahone tshelete yau ya u thoma ya R80,000 ya thankha i a swika phanda ha masiari.
choice.climax_choice_captured.label: [A HU NA NDILA] Wo farwa kha vhupo ha Pier 2
choice.climax_choice_captured.desc: Hu si na rekhodo yo talutshedzwaho kana manifest ya Berth 14, vha TRT vha Mokoena vha a u thivhela phanda ha u swika kha quay.
choice.climax_choice_captured.log: Goloi nna dza TRT Golf GTI dzo si na zwiga dzo thivhela u shavha hau mvulani. Docket #409 yo farwa phanda ha u tsha ha.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Paranoia ya Vhusiku: U wa ha mafulufulu
event.evt_composure_breakdown.location: Mercury Arcade Stairwell • Vhukati ha u netesa
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Muhumbulo wa nga ngomu
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Zwanḓa zwau a zwi litshi u rema. Vhukati ha mosi ya jenereitha, u lila ha siren dza Queen Street, na miṅwedzi ya rathi u tshi khou sedza murahu hau, vhona hau vhu khou vha tshipiringi tsha mosi.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: U khou wela kha stairwell ya Mercury Arcade, u tshi khou kondelwa u fema. Arali u sa dzikisa mbilu yau zwino, u do ita phoso ya u fa.
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.label: Renga Amphetamines dza vhukati ha vhupo kha Arcade Kiosk (R500)
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.desc: Zwi kombetshedza u sedza hau u vhuya zwino (+45% Composure), naho muthengisi a tshi amba (+1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.log: Maphilisi a vhavhaho a tshi vusa nungo dzau (+45% Composure, +1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.labe: Daedza Mudzivhanyi wa Colonel van der Merwe (Hawks Rep >= 1)
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.desc: Shumisa vhulivhi hau ha Hawks u wana tshithu tsha adrenaline na u sedza vhuvhi (+50% Composure).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.log: Mudzivhanyi wa Hawks o no pambalala o u alafha nga ngomu ha goloi i si na zwiga (+50% Composure, -1 Sweep).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.label: Edela fhasi ha safehouse u swika u sa tsha rema
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.desc: U wana +35% Composure mahala, fhedzi u lahlekelwa nga awara dza ndeme musi Mokoena a tshi khou u kanda (+1 Sweep, +1 Nandi’s Wound).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.log: U vhuka nga murahu ha awara nnzhi kha phansi ya linoleum (+35% Composure, fhedzi Threat Clocks i a ya phanda).
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Wire yo dzumbiwaho: Thavha ya 4th-Floor
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.speaker: Muofisiri Muhulwane wa Councillor Ma-Sibi
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Musi teksi dza masiari dzi tshi khou lila nga Queen Street, foni yau ya burner i a rema nga mulaedza wa Signal u tshi bva kha 4th Floor ya City Hall.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Ri a zwi divha uri Constable Nandi o u ṱisela mapepala a Mandla Sithole. A hu na muthu City Hall ane a toda tshiṅwe tshililo. Dzikisa u sedza hau namusi, nahone R800 ya consulting retainer ya masipala i do vha i tshi khou vhewa kha poso yau nga ngomu ha awara."
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.lab: Tambela R800 "Consulting Retainer" & U tambe navho
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.des: Wana R800 nahone u wane +1 City Hall Rep, fhedzi zwi dzhia -10% Composure musi u tshi khou kondelela vhufulu.
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.log: Courier i vhea envelope ya masipala na R800 ya tshelete kha poso yau ya arcade (+R800, +1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.label: Trace murahu ha Burner Message Header (WIRE >= 1)
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.desc: Shumisa vhukoni hau ha signals u bvisa metadata kha mulaedza wa Chief of Staff (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.log: U fara setifikeiti ya server ya masipala kha header ya mulaedza (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.label: Fhata Burner SIM vhukati & U bvele phanda u tshi khou toda
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.desc: U hana u renga (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep, -1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.log: U fhata SIM card vhukati nahone wa i lahlela kha gutter ya mvula (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep).
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Morning Dispatch: Umgeni Feeder Cable yo thubiwa
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.location: West Street & Umgeni Corridor • Cycle 3 Dawn
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Mosi mutswu wo no vha ntha ha substation ya Umgeni nga matsheloni. Sindikate ya u thuba koporo yo thuba thambo tharu dza high-voltage vhusiku, zwi tshi ita uri traffic lights dza CBD dzi vhe na thaidzo.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Marshals a Bra Bheki o dzhia vhudzulo kha zwipambani na zwiṱiringo na sjamboks, musi goloi dza SAPS dzi tshi khou vha na thaidzo dza traffic zwikwata zvivhili kule.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.label: Thusa Marshals a Bra Bheki u reroute Morning Rank
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.desc: Wana R500 ya tshelete kha marshals a rank na +1 Street Syndicate standing.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.log: U bvisa ndila ya u ṱisela ya Quantums dza Bra Bheki nahone wa wana R500 (+R500, +1 Street Syndicate Rep).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.label: Shumisa ukhukhuliseka ha magesi u ite u phumudze khamera dza Precinct ANPR
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.desc: Shumisa u fhambana ha magesi u phumudze zwirekhodi zwa nomboro dza goloi (-2 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.log: U fhambana ha magesi ho tshinyadza zwirekhodi zwa khamera dza tshitiriti zwa awara dza 24 dza Central Precinct (-2 Precinct Heat).
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Urumo lwa u tavhanya: MV Southern Cross i khou dzhena Berth 14
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Phala i khou lila kha mume wa tshikhepe musi MV Southern Cross i tshi khou bva vhukati ha madi. Radio yau yo dzumbiwaho i khou lila na ipfi la Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Thetshelesa zwavhudi. Midumbelo ya kemikhala ya Zuko Ndlovu i khou bviswa Berth 14 vhusiku vhuno, nahone vhanu vha TRT vha Mokoena vho no vha hone vha khou lindela. Itani vhungoho uri ni vha na Decoded Tanker Ledger kana Berth 14 Manifest phanda ha vhusiku vhu tshi swika."
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.label: Tola Dossier yau ya vhuṱanzi u ite u lugela vhusiku vhuno
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.desc: U ḓiimisela u ite u vha na vhuṱali vhusiku vhuno (+15% Composure).
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.log: MV Southern Cross i khou vha tshipitini. Vhusiku vhuno ndi u lindela kwa u fhedzisela ha Berth 14 (+15% Composure).
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.title: U thuntshana kha M4 Flyover
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.location: Umhlanga M4 Highway Overpass • Vhusiku vhukati
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.speaker: Izinkabi dza nnda ha vundu
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p1: Bakkie mbili dza vhatshena dzi si na layisentsi dzo vala goloi yau kha mbingano ya M4. Muvhala wa thuntsho u khou vhonala kha mvula musi thuntsho ya vhuthuntshi i tshi khou vha na mitshelo kha windo yau.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: Zuko na Brigadier Mokoena vho rumela vhalai vhavho vha nnda ha vundu u ite uri u songo vhuya wa swika kha High Court witness stand.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.label: Gwedza Bakkie ya phanda u ite u thuntsha u vhuya (STREET >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.desc: U phusukanya tshiphingo nga vhutsila (-2 Hit Squad, -10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.log: Wo gwedza bakkie ya phanda u i wisa kha guardrail wa shavhela kha mitalo ya northern township (Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.label: Rumela R900 nga Bra Bheki’s Rank Marshals u ite u thivhela contract
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.desc: Shumisa vhukonani ha syndicate na R900 ya tshelete u renga vhalai.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.log: Lufhalo luthihi lwa Queen Street lwo ita uri vhalai vha lithe u u tevhelela (-R900, Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.label: Shavhela kha mugero wa madi a mvula
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.desc: U tshila u na khombo (-30% Composure, +1 Contempt Warrant), fhedzi u shavha vhupo ha u thuntshana.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.log: Goloi yau yo tshinyala nga thuntsho musi u tshi khou wela kha mugero (-30% Composure, Hit Squad reset).
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.title: State Security Contempt Warrant
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.speaker: Advocate Vermeulen
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p1: Vhalindi vha zwibada na vha State Security vho u tanga kha masitepe a High Court, vha tshi khou tikisa ndaela ya u u fara yo sainiwaho nga Protection of State Information Act.
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "U khou farwa zwino nga nṱha ha u vha na zwirekhodi zwa municipal infrastructure zwi si zwa mulayo."
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.label: Tshimbidza Section 205 Whistleblower Immunity (DOCKETS >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.desc: Tshinyadza warrant ya vhufhura phanda ha khothe (+1 Hawks Rep, resets Contempt Warrant).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.log: Judge Khumalo o tshinyadza warrant ya u fara phanda ha vhathu na khamera dza TV (Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.label: Lifha R800 Emergency Senior Counsel Bail
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.desc: Lifha R800 ya vhureri u ite u dzula u si na khothe.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.log: Vha mulayo vhau vho wana interdict ya u ite uri u dzule u tshi khou tshila (-R800, Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.label: Shavhela kha mugero wa Magistrates’ Basement
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.desc: Shavha u farwa fhedzi u lahlekelwa nga -25% Composure na +1 Hit Squad heat.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.log: Wo shavhela kha mugero wa archive phanda ha musi vha tshi u fara (-25% Composure, +1 Hit Squad).
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.title: U wanala ha vhuṱanzi: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.location: High Court Evidence Vault • Encrypted Uplink
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p1: Printer ya Colonel van der Merwe yo thoma u shuma, ya bvisa register ya vhane vha Sovereign Pearl Holdings ya DIFC Dubai.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: Zwo nwalwa zwavhudi: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), na Brigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—pamwe na charter ya Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) i khou lindela King Shaka Hangar 7 na vhuṱanzi ha Lot 44 ya Midlands.
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.labe: Tenda Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed & Unlock Inland Leads
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.desc: I engedza Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed kha inventory yau nahone i vula Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.log: Ndo wana Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed! Ndo vhula Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) na King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.title: Tshiphiri tsho vhulea: Midlands Packhouse Telemetry
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p1: Zwo dzumbululwaho nga GPS ya Sparks zwi tshimbidzana zwavhuḓi na mapepu a vhulimi a vhukati ha shango. Ma-tanker othe a maḓi a masipala o rekhodwaho a tshi ya kha dziphurothini dza devhula, a vhukuma o vha a tshi khou ya N3 highway u ya kha Lot 44: Hydroponic Citrus Estate.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Tsha u fhira, manifests a thundu a sumbedza 1.8 metric tons ya crystal yo fhelelaho yo takelwaho kha mapalete a citrus a tshi khou ya Hangar 7 kha King Shaka International Airport vhusiku vhunwe na vhunwe.
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.label: Rekhoda Midlands Batch Telemetry na u vhula Inland Targets
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.desc: I engedza Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry kha inventory yau na u vhula Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) na King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.log: Ndo wana Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry! Ndo vhula Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) na King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.t: Mafhungo a Matsheloni: U ofha kha Umhlanga Ridge
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.p: Mapepha a mafhungo a KwaZulu-Natal othe a na thero khulwane dza Commission of Inquiry. Kha Umhlanga Ridge, vhashumi vha khou shuma nga maanḓa u thutha mapepha musi vha-direkthara vha shell-company vha tshi khou lingedza u vhuela lifhathoni u bva King Shaka.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.la: Vhudza Court Press Gallery (+1 Trace Trust, +1 Contempt)
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.de: Tutshela vhathu vha tshi khou sedza Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.lo: Mapepha au a mafhungo o ita uri vha-direkthara vha banki vha vhe vha tshi khou ofha (+1 Trace Trust).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.label: Shandukisa Goloi dza Safehouse na u dzumba Nandi
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.desc: Tutshela vha-sedzi vha Zuko vha tshi khou u tevhelela (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.log: U shandukisa nomboro dza goloi kha garage, u tshi sia hit squad i tshi khou mona-mona hotela yo vhofholowaho (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: U Phaphela Hangar 7: U Fhela ha Mafhungo
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.speaker: Zuko Ndlovu, Cllr. Ma-Sibi & Brig. Mokoena
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Mvula ya vhusiku i khou rova Hangar 7. Rolls-Royce turbines dza Gulfstream ZS-900 dzi khou rila musi vhashumi vha tshi khou takela thundu ya vhukhudo na diplomatic pouches.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Kha vhupo ha airstairs hu na vha-vhumbi vhararu vha eThekwini-Gold: Zuko Ndlovu a ambere trench coat, Councillor Ma-Sibi a farele diplomatic passport, na Brigadier Mokoena a farele pfuti ya mureo a tshi khou sedza tarmac.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Mise ya thanu u swika u phaphela, Warrant Officer," Zuko u amba nga ntha ha rila la jet. "Kha u khethe uri ndi shango lifhio line wa ḓo vhuka u tshi vhona matshelo."
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.labe: [CONSTITUTIONAL RECKONING] Vhofha vhathu vha High Court & Imisa ZS-900
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.desc: Zwi ṱoḓa Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed kana Super-Lab Telemetry. Ranga phanḓa Hawks ya Col. van der Merwe u swika tarmac na u vhofha vhararu vhenevho kha television ya lushaka.
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.log: Goloi dza Hawks dzo vala runway musi u tshi khou vhofha vhathu nga pfuti.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.lab: [DRY-TAP UPRISING] Fara Tanker Fleet na u Ṋea Midlands Millions vhathu vha Townships
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.des: Zwi ṱoḓa Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed kana Super-Lab Telemetry. Ṋea vhashumi vha Bra Bheki nḓila ya u vhula Hangar 7, u fara R400m ya syndicate, na u vhula maḓi.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.log: Madana a minibus taxis na municipal tankers o vhula fence, a fara pfuma ya cartel u itela vhathu vha vhupo ho omaho.
choice.choice_act2_ending_syndicate_stat: [THE GHOST SOVEREIGN] Sia Flight ZS-900 i tshi ya u itela Master Trust Keys
Zwi ṱoḓa Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed kana Super-Lab Telemetry. Sia vha-polotiki vha tshi shavhela Dubai musi u tshi dzula vhuimo ha vhulivhisi ha shadow logistics empire.
Zuko u u ṋea master cryptographic key musi ZS-900 i tshi khou ya runway i tshi ya kha maḓumbu.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.label: [UNARMED ON THE APRON] Sedzana na Triumvirate u si na vhuṱanzi
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.desc: Arali wo swika Hangar 7 u si na Trust Deed kana Super-Lab Telemetry, vhalindi vha Mokoena vha ḓo vala dzigoda dza hangar nga murahu hau.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.log: U si na vhuṱanzi ha High Court, mboni dza hangar dzo dzima na rila la jet lo thivhela tshipfela tshau tsha u fhedzisela.

ending.ending_kingpin.title: Fhasi ha 20 Percent ya Taps
ending.ending_kingpin.subtitle: Penthouse Atop the Harbour Grain Silos • Vhukati ha vhusiku
ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "Kha eThekwini-Gold, a hu na ane a nga kunda murendeni. U a fa u tshi khatiwa nga dziphula, kana wa renga tshipiḓa tsha u vhumba vhavhusi."
ending.ending_kingpin.hook: U SEDZA TSHIPIḒA TSHA 2: Mufarisa Nandi o hana tshelede ya madi a mbilu ya vhathu vha tshi fa, a shavhela kha dziphula a tshi hwala khophi ya dokeṱe—zwi tshi u kombetshedza uri u tsimele vhukati ha vhathu vhe wa vha u tshi shuma navho.
ending.ending_captured.title: O fumbelwa kha Shaft 9
ending.ending_captured.subtitle: Hune ha tshi vha ho fhela u tshi vhumbwa musina na musina wa musuku kule na dorobo • Phanda ha u tsha
ending.ending_captured.quote: "Dorobo a i ṱoḓi khothe musi hu tshi vha na u tima ha muvhuso wa Stage 6 na bakkie i si na nomboro i tshi ita mushumo phanda ha u tsha."
ending.ending_captured.hook: LINGEDZA LUNWE LUFHELANI: Dzudzanya vhuimo hau, shumisa vhukwamani ha thekisi ya Queen Street u itela u fhungudza tshifhinga tsha Mokoena, nahone u vhule Pier 2 phanda ha musi vhathu vha tshi u fara.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.title: U vhonala kha Thelevishini ya Lushaka
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.subtitle: King Shaka Hangar 7 na Maanḓa a Khothe ya Nṱha • U tsha
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Lwa u thoma nga murahu ha miṅwaha ya fumi na fumi, siren dza mapholisa dzo vha dzi sa khou vhula ndila ya vhavhusi vhahulwane—dzo vha dzi tshi khou vha fara nga zwanḓa zwo tshinywa."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: MUSHUMO WO FHELA (TSHIPIḒA 1 + TSHIPIḒA 2): Wo ponyoka u tima ha muvhuso, wa vhula tshiphiri tsha Sovereign Pearl, nahone wa isa vhavhusi vha eThekwini-Gold vha sa farwi kha vhulamukanyi.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.title: Convoy ya Vhathu
ending.ending_act2_revolution.subtitle: Northern Township Reservoir na Hangar 7 • U tsha
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Vho tswa madi vha ri rengisela gomelelo. Madekwana a namusi ro dzhia dzigoloi, dziphombi, na akhaunthu ya banka."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: MUSHUMO WO FHELA (TSHIPIḒA 1 + TSHIPIḒA 2): Wo thutha vhulamukanyi ha muvhuso wa vhathu vha re na maanḓa nahone wa vhuyedza madi a eThekwini-Gold kha vhathu vhayo.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.title: Mulanguli wa Bodo
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.subti: Umhlanga Ridge Penthouse 01 • Vhukati ha vhusiku
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Muvhuso a u tshinyali musi khosi i tshi khwela davhi. Vha sokou shandukisa saino kha vhukwamani ha thest."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: MUSHUMO WO FHELA (TSHIPIḒA 1 + TSHIPIḒA 2): Wo kunda vhathu vhoṱhe vha eThekwini-Gold nahone wa dzhia vhuimo ha vhulamukanyi ha vhusiku.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.title: O valelwa miṅwaha ya fumi na fumi
ending.ending_act2_vanished.subtitle: King Shaka Cargo Apron • 01:15 AM
ending.ending_act2_vanished.quote: "Nga ndaela ya Mulanguli, Exhibit 409-B i khou vhewa fhasi ha milayo ya National Key Points."
ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: LINGEDZA TSHIPIḒA 2 LUNWE: Fhedza tshifhinga tsha "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" (kha The Ridge kana Khothe ya Nṱha) kana tshifhinga tsha "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" (kha Northern Township Depot) phanda ha u thivhela Flight ZS-900!
bg.forensic_hawk.title: Muodithi wa Vhushaka ha Maphepha
bg.forensic_hawk.tagline: Ni tevhela dziRanda kha khamphani dza mazwifhi na thendara dza masipala.
bg.forensic_hawk.desc: Brigadier Mokoena o ni pomoka vhukhakhi musi u sedzulusa hanu ha dzi-tanker dza madi dza masipala hu tshi sendela tsini na Holo ya Dorobo. A ni koni u lwa na tshigwada tsha vhabulayi zwifhatuwo zwo livhana, fhedzi arali na newa bukhu ya masheleni na mukwaleli wa khothe, ni nga wisa muvhuso wothe.
bg.trt_breacher.title: Mupangi o Swaho
bg.trt_breacher.tagline: Ni a divha uri zwigwada zwa polao zwa Mokoena zwi shuma hani ngauri no vha ni tshi rhangela tshithihi tshazwo.
bg.trt_breacher.desc: No thutha minwango u bva KwaMashu u swika Point u swikela ni tshi hana ndaela ya u dzudzanya u thuntshana kha Pier 2. Muphuresidente munwe na munwe wa thekhisi na mulanguli wa tshititshi vha a divha tshifhatuwo tshenu—nahone vha thonifha ndaela ya tshibalesa tshanu.
bg.crime_intel.title: Muthetshelesi wa Dzi-wire wa Tshipuku
bg.crime_intel.tagline: Kudzhenelele kwa thawa dza founu, dzi-transponder dza mazwifhi, na u tshuvisa zwi si mulayoni.
bg.crime_intel.desc: No vha ni tshi dzula murahu ha veni i si na tshiga ni tshi thetshelesa vharangaphanda vha dzikharteli vha tshi hevhedza kha makhanselara a dorobo. Musi munwe a tshi phumula seva khulwane a ni pomoka zwone, no vhulunga dzi-hard drive dzo tsireledzwaho dzo tumbiswa CBD yothe.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Nga awara ya mbili, muvhuso u a tima nga u tshipa ha substation ya Queen Street. Fan ya tshiṱanga i a ima. Nnda ha windo, mvula ya madi i khou rwa dzinthanga dza Mercury Arcade, i tshi vhonala fhedzi nga mulilo wa generator ya spaza shop.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Kha desiki yau hu na botolo ya cane spirits na phepere ya u imiswa mushumo yo sainiwaho nga Brigadier Titus Mokoena miṅwaha ya rathi yo fhiraho.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Huno hu ḓa muvhigo—hu si kha buzzer ya fhasi, fhedzi nga u rwa ha tharu dza vhathu vha tshi khou rwa Trellidor yau ya tsimbi. Phanda ha u swika kha 9mm Parabellum ya fhasi ha mbedzi yau, humbula uri wo vha u nnyi phanda ha musi Mokoena a tshi tshinyadza mushumo wau:
popt.pick_forensic.label: Khetha Background: Muongolosi wa Phepere (+2 Dockets, +1 Influence)
popt.pick_breacher.label: Khetha Background: Muphulusi o Tshivhaho (+2 Street, +1 Dockets)
popt.pick_intel.label: Khetha Background: Muphulusi wa Wiretapper (+2 Wire, +1 Influence)
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: U vhula Z88 yau nahone u ima thungo ya vhothi. Nga peephole, bulb ya tshiimo i khou vhonala kha windbreaker ya SAPS yo ṱavhaho.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Ndi Mufarisa Nandi—roki a woṱhe kha sitatshini we a hana u saina affidavit ya Mokoena ya mazwifhi nga ha iwe. U khou fara mbabvu dza tshanḓa tsha monde, madi a tshi khou bva, a tshi hwala dokeṱe ya brown na smartphone yo tshinyalaho.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." u a hema, maṱo a tshi sedza murunzini wa stairwell. "Vhulani vhothi. Ndi khou humbela. Dzigoloi dza Mokoena dza TRT dzo no fhira thekisi. Arali radio yanga i tshi kha ḓi shuma, vha khou ḓa nga murahu ha mita mbili."
popt.opt_wire_kill_radio.label: [WIRE] Phumula bhatiri na GPS module kha handset ya SAPS yayo u thoma
popt.opt_street_clear_alley.label: [STREET] Sedza alley, mu dzhenise nnda, nahone u valele vhothi
popt.opt_standard_pull_in.label: Vhulani Trellidor nahone u mu dzhenise kha phuloro ya tshiṱanga
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: U kanda thaole yo kunaho kha mbabvu dzayo. 9mm hollow-point yo mu rwa mbabvu—yo dzika u itela u bvisa madi, yo vha i khombo u i vhunga kha sibadela tsha muvhuso hune mapholisa vha ṅwala vhathu vhoṱhe vho thuntshiwaho.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi u kusha Dokeṱe #409 na smartphone yo tshinyalaho zwanḓani zwau. "Ro vha ri tshi khou ya kha Cash-in-Transit heist kha N2 south ramp nga vhukati ha vhusiku. Goloi ya G4S yo vha yo thuntshiwa nga C4, Warrant. Fhedzi ho vha hu si na tshelede ngomu."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: U mila madi, a tshi khou tetemela. "Ho vha hu na muongolosi wa muvhuso o farwaho nga zwanḓa kha phuloro, na ledger iyi. Rands dza 400 million dza thendara dza madi dzo rumiwa nga ofisi ya Councillor Ma-Sibi u ya kha warehouses dza Zuko Ndlovu. Musi mufarisa wanga a tshi lingedza u ṅwala, Brigadier Mokoena o swika nga bakkie ya TRT... a mu thuntsha tshifuvhani."
popt.opt_dockets_inspect.label: [DOCKETS] Vhulani Dokeṱe #409 nahone u sedze saino dza treasury authorisation
popt.opt_influence_calm_nandi.label: [U KHWATHISA] "Femba, Nandi. Mokoena a a ḓivhi uri iyi phulathi i hone. U kha ḓi vha muphulusi."
popt.opt_ask_phone.label: "Foni iyi ndi ya nnyi? Nahone nnyi munwe we a u vhona u tshi shavha kha N2?"
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.time: 05:45 AM // TSHIFHINGA TSHA U TSHA KHA DOWANI
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi u a lala kha sofa yau musi vhuedzi vhu tshi khou bva nga mafelelo a daka. Nnda, mimotokara ya minibhasi i thoma u lila kha Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: U na thaidzo mbili dzi tshi khou vhaisa: Vhulwadze ha Nandi ha tshiphiri tsha thobolo vhu ḓo vhavha nga maanda nga murahu ha maḓuvha mana arali u sa badela nganga ya tshiphiri (R1,500), nahone maswole a Brigadier Mokoena a TRT a khou tshetshelesa vhupo hothe.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Zwanḓani zwau hu na vhuṱanzi vhu vhofhaho City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, na Abasanta Cartel. Daisi dzau dza ḓuvha na ḓuvha dzi khou ḓugela kha thebulu.
popt.opt_start_game.label: Tshimbila u ye kha Mepu ya Tshikiliti (Thoma Tshipiḓa tsha 1)
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.title: U Phusukanya Server ya Fiduciary Escrow
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.desc: Tshimbila u dzhene kha server ya vhuṱali ya tshiphiri kha phuloro ya 28 u tevhelela Sovereign Pearl offshore shell trust.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.clean: U dzhena ho kunaho. U khophi certificate dza DIFC Dubai phanḓa ha musi firewall ya vhulamukanyi i tshi khou ita tshithu.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.compromise: U bvisa hafu ya rejisitiri, fhedzi alamo i sa lili i vhiga MAC address yau kha vha mulayo (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.failure: Mivalo ya biometrics i a valea. U shavha nga tshiphiri musi vhalindi vha tshi khou ṱoḓa vhupo.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.title: U Sindedza Consultant ya Tender kha Sky-Bar
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.desc: Vhofha gweta la Councillor Ma-Sibi la mithelo ya nnda nga scotch na u ṱoḓa tshelede ya tshiphiri.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.clean: U u ṋea platinum casino chip na R1,100 ya tshelede kha thebulu ya marble, a fulufhedzisa u imisa warrant ya contempt.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.compromis: U badela R650 u itela uri dzina lawe li si vhe kha luthere, naho mulindi wawe a tshi ṋa photo ya nomboro dza motokara yau.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.failure: U a u sea nahone a vhidza vhalindi vha Commission u vhiga u tshi khou vhaisa vhathu.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.title: U Bvisa Black-Box GPS kha Tanker #114
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.desc: Vhula dashboard telemetry ya tanker ya masipala u tevhelela vhuimo hayo vhusiku kha Midlands.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.clean: Musi vhalindi vha Bra Bheki vha tshi khou vhona, u bvisa Howick highway coordinates (+2 Lab Telemetry).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.compromised: U bvisa GPS module, fhedzi muvhoni wa cartel a tshi khou vhona murunzi wau (+1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.failure: Wiring ya motokara i a phuphuma, ya vhidza vhalindi vha depot vha re na zwibobolo.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.title: U Vhambedzana na Strike Committee (R400)
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.desc: Badela vhalindi vha maḓi a vhupo u itela u vhumba barricades dza vhathu dze dza ḓo imisa hit squads dza cartel.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.clean: Mavhili a tshi khou swa na barricades zwi vala nḓila dza devhula—vhalwi vha Zuko vha a shavha (-2 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.compromis: Vhalindi vha strike vha shandula nḓila dza vhathu u mona na vhuphulusi hau (-1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.failure: SAPS Nyalas i phadaladza vhathu nga stun grenades phanḓa ha musi barricade i tshi khwaṱha.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.title: U Fhata Section 205 Offshore Subpoena
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.desc: Shuma na vhalanguli vha vhuṱanzi vha Colonel van der Merwe u sindedza mabanki u vhula Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.clean: Judge Khumalo u saina oda. Ofisiri ya banki i rumela wire transfers nga tshifhinga tsha awara (+2 Trust, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.compromi: Gweta la vhupileli li rumela interdicts, fhedzi u wana phepha la u saina (+1 Trust).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.failure: Gweta la Mokoena li u pomoka u vhumba vhuṱanzi kha khothe (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.title: U Vhudzana kha Safe-Room ya Vhutanzi (R300)
slot.slot_recess_debrief.desc: Nwa kofi na u ṱanzwa mbono kha Hawks chambers nga fhasi ha Courtroom A u itela u khwaṱhisa mbilu.
slot.slot_recess_debrief.clean: Constable Nandi—ane a khou tshimbila nga crutches—u sedzulusa tshifhinga tshau nga rooibos tea (+25% Composure, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.compromised: Awara mbili dza u lala nga murahu ha glass ya bulletproof zwi khwaṱhisa muhumbulo wau (+15% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.failure: Vhavhiga-mafhungo vha khou rwa mivalo ya chambers duvha lothe, u a vha na nungo thukhu (+5% Composure).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.title: U Phusukanya Packhouse B Synthesis Vats
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.desc: Shavha mbo vhalindi u ṋa photo dza tanker dza masipala dze dza vha dzi tshi khou pompa precursor kha citrus packhouse. Stage 6 i tima electric fence (+2).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.clean: Nga fhasi ha duvha u ṋa photo dza synthesis line na u wana R900 kha safe ya foreman.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.compromis: U wana serial numbers, fhedzi mbono i a vhonala musi mbo dza Rottweiler dzi tshi khou rwa fence.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.failure: Vhalindi vha tshiphiri vha thoma u thubula nga R5 rifles. U shavha nga nḓila ya maḓi u tshi khou nwa zwikhemikhali.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.title: [FINALE] U Thoma Midlands Super-Lab
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.desc: Eta vhalindi vha strike kana Hawks tactical team u ya Packhouse B phanḓa ha musi vhuṱanzi vhu tshi swa.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.clean: U phusukanya mivalo ya packhouse na u fara master ledger—u sindedza Zuko na Mokoena u shavhela Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.compromised: Nga fhasi ha thubulo ya zwibobolo u wana synthesis vats musi syndicate convoy i tshi khou gidimela King Shaka Airport!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.failure: Packhouse i a swa, zwi tshi vhidza u lwa ha u fhedzisela kha King Shaka Hangar 7!
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.title: U Vhofha Gulfstream ZS-900 Avionics
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.desc: Shandula radar transponder u imisa nnde ya Zuko ya Dubai. Stage 6 i tima radar ya tarmac (+2).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.clean: U dzhenisa vhuṱanzi ha zwikanganwi kha flight computer ya ZS-900, u imisa u bva ha nnde (-1 Flight Countdown, -1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.compromis: Vhulangi ha Air Traffic Control vho farela tshifofoni tsha charter kha taxiway threshold (-1 Flight Countdown).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.failure: Vha-snipers vha SAPS TRT vha re ntha ha hangar vho vhona laser link yau vhukati ha tarmac yo tswukaho.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.title: [FINALE] Farelani Tshifofoni ZS-900 kha Hangar 7
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.desc: Tshimbilani nga goloi ni tshi ya kha apron yo nethwaho nga mvula sa Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, na Brigadier Mokoena vha tshi khou namela Gulfstream.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.clean: Mboni dza goloi yau dzo tshea phanda ha Gulfstream—u thivhela taxiway u itela u fhedzisela!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.compromised: Wo phusukanya tshiphiringo tsha Hangar 7 musi injini dza tshifofoni dzi tshi khou thoma u shuma!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.failure: U tshi khou thuntshiwa nga vhalindi vha Mokoena, wo tshiphuka wa wela kha apron musi masitepisi a u namela a tshi khou humela murahu!
clock.cartel_hit_squad.desc: Zuko na Brigadier Mokoena vho thola vhathu vha u thuntsha vha bva nga nnda ha vundu u itela u u kunakisa phanda ha musi Khomishini i tshi khunyelela.
clock.commission_subpoena.title: Tshiphiringo tsha U sa thetshelesa na Tshirevhedzo
clock.commission_subpoena.desc: Vha-prosecutor vho tshinyalaho vha re kha Inquiry vha khou lugisa waranti ya u u farela nga fhasi ha milayo ya Tshirevhedzo tsha Muvhuso.
clock.trace_offshore_trust.title: Tevhelela Sovereign Pearl Trust
clock.trace_offshore_trust.desc: Vhambedzani vharegistara vha vhubindudzi vha Umhlanga Ridge na subpoena dza Khothe ya Ntha u itela u vhonisa vhane vha Dubai.
clock.compile_ballistics_file.title: Vhumbani Telemetry ya Super-Lab
clock.compile_ballistics_file.desc: Bvisani logi dza GPS dza dzigoloi dza madi dza Northern Township dzo farelwaho u itela u wana fhethu hune ha khou itelwa hone kemikhali.
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.title: U Bva ha Tshifofoni tsha ZS-900
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.desc: Countdown u swika Zuko Ndlovu, Ma-Sibi, na Mokoena vha tshi namela Gulfstream i yaho Dubai kha King Shaka Hangar 7.
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.role: Mubviseli-Nnda o Khakhamalwaho • Mboni ya Ntha
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "U songo vula mboni, Sbu. Goloi dza Golf GTI dza Mokoena dzi khou mona-mona Anton Lembede Street nga murahu ha mimunithi ya fumi-mbili. A vho ngo tou vhulaha Auditor Sithole fhedzi kha weighbridge ya Umgeni—vho vha vho mu lindela vho no tswula na transponder dza port."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Zwoṱhe zwe Sithole a fela zwone zwi ngomu ha Docket #409 na iyo foni yo tshinyalaho. Ndi vhudze uri a ro ngo fa nḓuni heyi vhusiku vhuno."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Ntsumbedze zwe zwa itea kha ambush ya weighbridge ya N2. Ndi nnyi o kwehaho trigger?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Sedzani na nne tshifhinga itshi tsha weighbridge. Ndi dziphuleiti dzifhio dza dzigoloi dze dza vha dzo dzumbama?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Netshedzani Vhuṱanzi: Ledger ya Madi yo ṱalutshedzwaho] "Ndo tevhelela khamphani iyi. Ma-Sibi na Zuko vhone vhane vha dzigoloi idzo."
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Humulani, Nandi. Valani vhurei musi nne ndi tshi khou shuma vhukati ha vhathu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Dzigoloi mbili dza mabone a blue dzo ri thivhela nga murahu ha off-ramp ya Umgeni. Brigadier Mokoena o vha a songo ambara na balaclava. O bva a ambere zwiambaro zwa TRT, a sedza briefcase ya Sithole, a vhudza corporal wawe uri a fhise goloi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ndo kukurutshela kha storm drain ndo fara folder ya manila nga fhasi ha vest yanga. Arali Sparks wa Golden Dragon a nga vula foni ya Sithole, ipfi la Mokoena li ngomu kha voice note."
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "A ri humele kha zwiitwa zwashu."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ndi do ita vhungoho uri iyo voice note i vhonwa nga vhathu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Sedzani—phuleiti ND-449-102 u swika 118. Vho vhudza City Hall uri vho shumisa mirioni ya fumi-ina ya Rand u isa madi a u nwa KwaMashu nga tshifhinga tsha gomelelo, fhedzi sedzani toll tags dza dizili. A vho ngo vhuya vha ya devhula."
"Dzigoloi dzoṱhe dzo livha Pier 2 Cold Storage nga 01:30 AM. Vho vha vha tshi khou hwala kemikhali ya Zuko Ndlovu vha tshi khou amba uri ndi madi a muvhuso."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Izwo zwo ntshedzela tshifhinga tshinzhi tsha u sedza ledger. Lindani."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... mirongo ya rathi ya Abasanta Maritime, mirongo ya ina ya trust ya Ma-Sibi. Wo i wana, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Isani hezwi kha Colonel van der Merwe kha Old Archive Basement—kana ni fhise Berth 14 inwi vhane. Naho zwi tshi vha zwifhio, a vha nga bvi vho kunaka."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Tshimbilani zwavhudi. Ri khou swika magumoni."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, ex-Hawk o dzhena Queen Street musi vhatukana vha Mokoena vha TRT vha tshi khou vhona minibhasi yothe kha Warwick Junction. U na vhuhali, Sbu, ndo zwi vhona."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "A hu na tshine tsha tshimbila kha CBD vhathukana vhanga vha sa tshi vhoni—a si Nyala dza SAPS, na dzigoloi dza madi dza muvhuso dze dza vha dzi tshi khou tshimbila nga vhusiku."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Vhatyairi vhau vha vhusiku vha ri mini nga dzigoloi dza madi?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Vhalindi vhau vha ntshelete nga mulandu wa Berea route truce. Bvisani phuleiti dzanga kha vhalindi vha Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Vhuthihi ha Queen Street vhu khou ima. Rank i nga ntshedzela tshelede ya u shuma?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Tshimbilani nga mabone a fhasi, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Thetshelesani zwavhudi. Idzo dzigoloi dzi na decals dza City Hall, ngoho? Fhedzi vhatukana vhanga vha shumaho vhusiku vha ri mavhili o kumedza nga u lema ha kemikhali, nahone vhathukana vha Abasanta vha khou tshimbila nga Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Musi vhomme vhashu KwaMashu vha tshi khou lindela madi kha dziphombi. Councillor Ma-Sibi u khou rengisa vhathu vhawe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Mafhungo a vhudi. A ri ambe nga zwinwe."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "A wo ngo hangwa ndila ine vhathu vha shuma ngayo, Sbu. Zwo itea. Dzigoloi dzanga tharu dzo thivhela goloi ya SAPS kha Monty Naicker Road. Ni na tshifhinga tsha u fema."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Ndo livhuwa, Bra Bheki."
"Nani hezwi zwi bvaho kha tshelede ya vhuthihi. Rengani dizili, ni vhofholole vhathu, kana ni thuse Nandi. Itani vhungoho uri Mokoena a pfise vhuṱungu nga u tshinyadza zwitarata zwashu."
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "Zwi do ya kha u thivhela convoy yavho."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.role: SAPS TRT Commander • Muvhoni wa Cartel
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Ee, ee. Sedzani zwine mvula ya vhuya nayo ofisini yanga. Wo imiswa mushumoni wa Hawks, Sbu—u da fhano zwi amba uri u khou toda u fa kana u na gweta li duraho vhukuma."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Constable Nandi u gai, nahone thikara ya mu-auditor wa masipala i gai?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ndi khou sokou sedza phetheni ya vhathu vha tshi khou pfuka mulayo, Brigadier. U khou ofha tshiṅwe tshithu kha N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs ya Pretoria yo no wana khophi ya Docket #409. Litsha u toda vhathu vhanga kana rothe ri a tsha."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ndi na izwi lino u tshi khou laedza u vhulaia vhathu ngei Umgeni, Titus. Mpha tshelede u itela uri ndi fhedze khophi yeneyo."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Vhusiku vhuvhudi, Brigadier. Sedzani zwavhudi musi hu tshi khou ima muya."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban i tshimbila nga ndaela, Sbu. Zuko u ita uri zwikwama zwi vhe zwa mulalo, Ma-Sibi u ita uri malaiti a dzule a tshi khou bva ngei City Hall, nahone Task Force yanga i ita uri hu vhe na mulalo. Mandla Sithole o humbula uri phetheni ya vhathu i nga imisa tshitimela."
"Neshani Nandi phanda ha vhukati ha vhusiku nga Duvha la 4, kana vhanna vhanga a vha nga tsha khokhonya vhiḽi yaṋu ngei Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Dzulani na yeneyo muhumbulo, Titus."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Imisani Car 4 na Car 7 kha tshipida tsha Victoria Embankment. Wo vha u tshi dzula u tshi zwi divha u tamba tshitamboni tsha vhushumeli, Sbu. Nakelwa nga awara dza fumi-na-ina dza ndwedzo—a zwi nga u tshidza musi Berth 14 i tshi khou bviswa."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_standdown_back.lab: "Zwo takadza u shuma na SAPS command."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Ndi hone Hawk yo no guda mutengo wa nama ngei eThekwini. Dzhiani iyi tshelede yo farwaho kha lokere. Litshani u vhea file ya u thetshelesa kha desiki ya Colonel van der Merwe, khamusi Zuko u do u litsha u tshila u swika vhege i tshi da."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Ri do vhona uri khirediti yaṋu i tshi tshimbila lwa tshifhinga tshingafhani."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Valani vhiḽi, mudi wanga, muya u khou onadza mahogany. Muṅwe na muṅwe mudini uno u a gungula musi malaiti a tshi ima kha Stage 6, ngeno hu si na ane a vhudzisa uri nnyi a badelaho zwa politiki."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "Wo vha u tshi khou nngwela-ngwela kha Procurement Registry B. Ndivhudze uri muongolosi o shoniswaho u toda mini kha zwa madi a tshipentshela."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Ndi ngani Sub-Station 14 i tshi dzula i tshi ima musi Pier 2 i tshi khou laula zwithu vhukati ha vhusiku?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Fhathi-nna wa muzana wa Zululand Aqua-Logistics ndi wa trust ya muṱa waṋu, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Mushumi waṋu o litsha ndondolo ya Sub-Station 14 kha fax. Ndi khou khophiha tshifhinga tsha u ima ha malaiti ngei port."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Nakelwa nga air-conditioning musi i tshi kha di shuma, Councillor."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding ndi khombo, Sbu—nga nnda ha musi u tshi divha uri ndi breaker ifhio ine wa fanela u i kokodza na uri lini. Musi Stage 6 i tshi swika ngei Point Waterfront, khamera dza Transnet a dzi tsha vhona tshithu lwa awara nṋa."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Khonani dza City Hall a dzi dzuli swiswini. Vhavhi vha wana maboho avho o farwa phanda ha musi malaiti a tshi vhuya."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Ndaela yo vhumbaho zwavhudi."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole o vha e mu-accountant wa vhuṱali ane a si na vhuṱali ha u tshila. Iwe, nga u ya nga u ya, u a pfesesa uri u na nungo."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Heino tshelede ya R500 ya retainer u bva kha ward fund. Litshani u vhea dzina la trust yanga kha dzikhasete, nahone ofisi yanga i nga kona u laula Eskom grid musi u tshi toda swiswi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ndi do dzhia retainer. Ri do vhona nga ha dzikhasete."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Vhashumi vha vhuṱali a vha wanali mudini uno. Zwivhuya—dzhiani phetheni ya telecoms. U do wana i tshi ya nga u tou livhisa kha crane ya Zuko ngei Berth 14."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ndo livhuwa vhukuma, Councillor."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Sedzani tripwire ngei tsini na umbrella stand, Sbu! Voltage ya Stage 4 yo no onadza oscilloscopes dzanga mbili, nahone vhathu vha cyber-crime vha Mokoena vha khou pinga thavha dzoṱhe dza cell vhukati ha Grey Street na harbour."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "Wo nndisela GraphemeOS brick ya Mandla Sithole? Foni yeneyo i na Abasanta remote-wipe daemon kha baseband chip."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Ndi mini kha foni ya mu-auditor tshine tsha ita uri Zuko na Mokoena vha ofhe nga u rali?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "A ri vhofheni JTAG pins ngomu ha Faraday cage phanda ha musi baseband i pinga thavha."
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Vhutshelani kofi ya Ethiopian kha gas burner nahone ni swipe foni yanga ya burner u itela SAPS IMSI-catchers."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Litshani Faraday cage yo valwa, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole o vha a si mu-accountant fhedzi—o vhea mic ngei Pier 2 Cold Storage. Phanda ha musi vha tshi rwa goloi yawe ngei N2, foni yawe yo vhulunga voice note ya sekoni dza 48 na container manifest ya MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Sedzani load shedding ya Stage 6. Nnda ha musi u tshi shumedza generator ya diesel, decryption rig yanga i a ima."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Zwo naka u zwi divha. A ri sedzeni bench."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Sedzani timing ya voltage—ro kona u pfuka biometric lock ya u thoma hu si na u thoma Abasanta wipe daemon. Pass iṅwe hafhu kha bench nahone drive iyi ndi yaṋu."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "U solda zwavhudi, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Ee, Central Precinct yo vha yo vhofha stingray tower kha SIM serial yaṋu ya kale. Ndo shandula baseband MAC address yaṋu uri i vhonale sa parking meter ya masipala. Nwanyi!"
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "Zwo swika hune zwa fanela u swika."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Sedzani ngei channel, Sbu. Ngala dza 60 dzi khou imela, zwikwama zwa 3000 nga duvha, nahone Pretoria i humbula uri phetheni ya phephe yo sainiwaho nga magistrate i a kona u laula harbour iyi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ndo fhaṱa Abasanta Logistics u bva kha shed nthihi ya cold-storage. Zwino u khou ima kha catwalk yanga u na ledger ya mu-auditor o faho. U da u tamba u vha hero, kana u da u pfesesa zwa vhushavhili?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "U khou shavhisa madi a vhathu vha vhupo u itela u hwala zwithu zwa khemikhala, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 yo khou ṱalulwa. Nne ntshenzele kha mbuelo dza logistics kana Hawks vha ḓo dzhena MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Vhalindi vhau vha crane kha Berth 14 vho no shandula shifts. Ndo no vhona fhethu hune vha sa vhone hone tsini na fuel valves."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Ri ḓo zwi lulamisa musi convoy ya vhukati ha vhusiku yo swika, Zuko."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall yo tswa budget ya ma miṅwaha ya fumi ndo sa athu hirisa tanker, Sbu. Ndo sokou hirisa malori avho a si na tshithu. Kha shango ili, zwiito zwa mupo zwi vha zwa ane a vhulunga diesel na u badela vhalindi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena ndi muthu wa tshiphiri, nahone Ma-Sibi ndi tshiṱuhu. Nthuse u kunakisa Berth 14 vhusiku vhunwe na vhunwe, nahone a u nga tsha ḓo tambula nga ha arende kha Mercury Arcade."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Muṅwe na muṅwe ane a vha na maanḓa u humbula uri ndi muṱaluli."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Muthu wa vhuṱali. Hawks vho u badela tshelede i si na tshipi nahone vha u kusha kha phele musi wo sendela tsini na ngoho. Nga u vhone izwi sa mbuelo yau ya u thoma u bva kha Berth 14. Musi vhukati ha vhusiku vhu tshi swika, ita uri convoy iyo i tshimbile."
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Ri ḓo vhona uri vhukati ha vhusiku vhu ḓisa mini."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "A zwi mangadzi uri tshigwada tsha Mokoena tsho u litsha kha N2. U tshimbila unga musi wa vhukati ha vhuimelo ha zwikepe. Vhudza Titus uri ndo litsha vhalindi vhawe vha harbour vhusiku vhunwe na vhunwe—arali ri tshi khou ṱoḓa u linga muṅwe na muṅwe, a ri zwi iteni hu si na vha sa ḓivhi tshithu vha tshi khou dzhenelela."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "U swika vhukati ha vhusiku kha Berth 14."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "Wo kona u fhira khamera dza khothe ya magistrate, Sbu. Zwivhuya. Tshipiḓa tsha Provincial Headquarters tshi khou badelwa nga Mokoena, ndi zwone zwe zwa ita uri ndi ṱutshele task force yanga fhano na mimashini ya 1980s microfiche."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "U khou vhonala u tshi khou tambula, ṅwananga—nahone ndo pfa uri Constable Nandi o rwiwa nga tshiphuli kha N2. Nthuse u vhudza uri wo ḓisa tshithu tshine tsha nga kona u ponyoka muhaṱuli wa High Court."
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Ndi ngani Hawks vha sa athu fara Mokoena na Ma-Sibi, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Pfa heyi audio file, Colonel. Mokoena o laya u rwiwa ha N2 ene muṋe."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Vhulunga vothi ḽa tshiphiri ḽo valwa, Colonel. Ndi khou ṱoḓa u fhedza."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ngauri tshifhinga tshoṱhe tshine nda ṅwala warrant Upstairs, muṅwe muthu kha Ministry u vhudza City Hall nga u ṱavhanya. Hu si na financial ledger NA audio ya Berth 14, muhaṱuli u ḓo lahla tshiphiri tshoṱhe phanḓa ha u ḽa zwiliwa zwa nga matsheloni."
"Arali ra rumela package yo fhelelaho ya ya kha The Daily Veld newsroom musi ri tshi khou vhulunga Nandi, a vha nga kona u i vhulunga."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Ngauralo ri ḓo fhira Upstairs roṱhe."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Mudzimu wanga... 'thivhani sedan yawe phanḓa ha Umgeni off-ramp nahone ni fhise briefcase.' Iyo ndi zwiipfi zwa Titus Mokoena, zwi tshi pfala zwavhuḓi."
"Ndi khou vhea goloi yau kha registry yashu ya federal diplomatic zwino u itela u thivhela Precinct Heat. Tshila u swika ri tshi phadadzela izwi, Sbu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Ndo livhuwa, Colonel."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Muya u khou ṱanzieka fhano kha Ridge, a si zwone, Sbu? Fhasi kha CBD vha khou fara Judicial Commission of Inquiry, vha tshi khou ita unga muhaṱuli o rothaho a nga kona u lulamisa miṅwaha ya fumi ya vhupulotiki ha municipal."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Suitcases dzanga dzi kale kha King Shaka Hangar 7. Ndi ngani u tshi khou gonya tshiṱhaho tshanga tsha girasi musi maḓumbu o no swika?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Sovereign Pearl Holdings ndi mini, nahone ndi ngani Gulfstream yo ḓadzwa mafura kha Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Muthu wau wa SWIFT o hangwa u phumula Dubai SWIFT mirror kha server ya 28th-floor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ndi na beneficial ownership schedule, Ma-Sibi. Renga tshipiḓa tshau u bva kha charge sheet yanga."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "U songo dzhena kha Gulfstream iyo, Councillor."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Muṅwe na muṅwe mu-politiki wa vhuṱali kha KwaZulu-Natal u ḓivha uri Rand ndi ya u renga nahone Dirham ndi ya u vhulunga. Sovereign Pearl i vhulunga zwifhinga zwa Dubai, citrus estate kha Midlands, na charter jet kha Hangar 7."
"Zuko u na 45 percent, nne ndi na 30, nahone Titus Mokoena u na 25 nga u vhulunga zwigidi zwo livhiswa kule na rine."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Tshipiḓa tsha tharu tsho lulamaho."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "Wo hack-a escrow terminal? U khou shuma nga maanḓa. Zwivhuya—vha-haṱuli vhane vha khou ṱoḓa u u fara vha khou thetshelesa coalition whip yanga. Ndi ḓo vha vhudza uri vha ṱavhanye u u fara."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Tshito tsha vhuṱali."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "I dzhie. Livhisa vhukali hau kha Midlands super-lab ya Zuko kana vha-rwi vha Mokoena—litsha musadzi wa musa a ye vhuaweloni hawe kha Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Ri ḓo vhona ane a ḓo kona u tshimbila."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Sedza heyi tankers ye ra i fara vhusiku ho fhiraho, Sbu! False baffles yo ṱanganywaho nga ngomu—yo oma unga pfupa kha tshipiḓa tsha maḓi, nahone ho sala chemical precursor residue kha hidden core."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Vhathu vha northern wards vho no netiswa nga u lindela High Court commissions. Vhakhanneli vhanga vho vala depot, nahone izinkabi dza Mokoena vha khou ṱoḓa iwe kha dzinḓila dza ridge."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Tankers dze dza farwa dzo vha dzi tshee na dash-mount GPS transponders?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "A ri bviseni GPS flash chips kha Lead Tanker #14 zwino nahone ri vhee vhathu vha u sedza vha hit squad."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Vala vothi ḽa depot, Bra Bheki. Ri khou ya u lwa na estate yavho."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Yoṱhe! Vhukati ha 1:00 AM na 4:00 AM, nṱhani ha u pompa maḓi u bva kha reservoir, aya malori o gonya N3 u ya inland kha hydroponic citrus estate tsini na Howick spur."
"Synthesize telemetry data iyo, Sbu, nahone u ḓo vha na coordinates dza super-lab ya Zuko ya inland."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Iyo ndi yone link yo hangwaho vhukati ha harbour na airport."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Heino flash module u bva kha Tanker #14! Nahone u songo vhilaela nga ha vha-rwi vha contract vha Joburg—sedan iṅwe na iṅwe i sa ḓivhiwi i dzhenaho northern corridor i ḓo valelwa nga 40 Quantums phanḓa ha u ḓadza magazine."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.role: Muṅwe wa vhaṅwali vha vhuṱanzi vha Komishini • DPCI Hawks
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Ndi a ni tanganedza kha Komishini ya Mbudziso, Sbu. Berth 14 yo vhofholola tshiphiri tsha vhuimavhakele, zwino tshigwada tsha vhuvhava tshi khou lwa na rine nga vhaimeleli vha re na maanda na ndaela dza tshiphiri dza State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Tshi tshi vhavha tsho fhira, ro thivhela mulingo wa ndila ya lifhasi ya vhufhufhi u bva King Shaka International. Lifhasi la vhufhufhi ZS-900—Gulfstream ya tshiphiri—yo ḓadzwa mafi kha Hangar 7 u itela u bvisa Zuko, Ma-Sibi, na Mokoena u ya Dubai."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "Ndi mini zwine ra zwi ṱoḓa u itela u thivhela Lifhasi la vhufhufhi ZS-900 na u vha fhedza tshoṱhe?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "A ri vhee khumbelo ya tshiphiri ya u hanedzana na vhuṱanzi u itela u thivhela ndaela ya u sa thetshelesa na u vhidza rekhodo dza escrow dza Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Colonel, tshimbidzani Komishini. Nne ndi khou ya u vhusa."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Vhuṱanzi vhuvhili vhu re na maanda: Twa u thoma, Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed u bva kha Ridge Penthouses ine ya sumbedza uri vho raru vha na tshigwada tsha vhuvhava. Twa vhuvhili, Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry u bva kha matanki a maḓi a devhula."
"Vhula vhuṅwe ha vhuṱanzi u itela u sumbedza Citrus Estate na King Shaka Hangar 7—kana u vhu fara vho raru arali u tshi ṱoḓa u vha vhofha vhoṱhe kha tarmac."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Ndi zwone, Colonel."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Tshipiḓa tsha mulayo tsho lugaho, Sbu. Zwenezwo zwi khou vhofha zwanda zwa vhaimeleli vha Ma-Sibi vha re na vhukhakhi lwa awara dza mahumi mana na malo, zwi tshi kombetshedza munwaleli wa Ridge u vhula rekhodo dza DIFC."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "A ri shumiseni tshikhala itshi."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "Wo tevhela matanki a maḓi u swika nṱha ha thavha, Sbu. Zwi a takadza. Vhathu vhanzhi vha ima musi vha tshi swika kha dzi-penthouse dza lufheleni lwa lwanzhe ngei Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Sedzani kha Packhouse B. Ma-orenzhi a Valencia kha conveyor ya nṱha, crystal ya vhuimo ha 99% ya u rumela nnda kha mabokisi a mazwifhi a re fhasi, a tshi ya nga u livhisa King Shaka Cargo Apron. Na iwe u khou ima vhukati ha mavhele anga."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "U khou shavhela Dubai nga Lifhasi la vhufhufhi ZS-900 vhusiku vhunwe. Architect u khou shavha?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Nomboro nṅwe na nṅwe ya batch na ndila ya tanki yo no vha hone fhethu huṅwe. Litshani tshigwada tshau tsha izinkabi na u lifha muthelo wa u shanduka."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Ri ḓo vhonana kha tarmac ya Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "U shavha? Hai, Sbu—ndi u lulamisa zwithu. Komishini ya Mbudziso i ṱoḓa tshiphiri, ngauralo Ma-Sibi na Mokoena vha khou ofha. Nga tshifhinga tshenetsho, zwiimiswa zwine ra zwi vhumba fhano zwi ita zwigidi zwa Euro 20 nga ṅwedzi."

"Musi u tshi swika Hangar 7 vhusiku, u ḓo vha na khetho: u ri fara u itela muvhuso une wa ḓo ri vhetshela vhaṅwe nga Lavhuvhili, u fhisa tshiimiswa na tshigwada tsha Bra Bheki, kana u dzhia vhotshivhula vha vhuhosi iwe muṋe."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Ri ḓo ita khetho iyo kha Hangar 7."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Vhafuthi vha Gauteng vha khou ima. Wo wana tshipiḓa kha thebulu, Sbu. Dzhia hezwi u bva kha safe ya packhouse—naho u humbule nga vhuronwane u sa athu tendela Colonel van der Merwe a tshi vhofha vhumatshelo."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "Ndi ḓo u vhona ngei airport."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Vhufelelo ha ndila ya vhufhufhi, Sbu! Injini dza Gulfstream dzo no vha dzo dzia, ndaela dza vhuimeleli dzo no vha hone, na vhathu vha khou ḓadza mabokisi a u fhedzisela kha hold."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "Wo ponyoka N2, wo ponyoka Pier 2, na tshigwada tshanga tsha vhuvhava. Amba zwi re mbiluni yau phanḓa ha musi masitepisi a tshi vhuya!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Arali wa gonya masitepisi ayo, Titus, u ḓo vha mutshavhi vhutshilo hau hoṱhe."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Hafe ya masergenti au a TRT a si kha lifhasi ilo, Titus. Ndo vha vhudza uri u khou vha litsha uri vha vhe vhone vhane vha ḓo vha na vhukhakhi kha Komishini."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Ndi tshifhinga tsha u fhedza hezwi kha tarmac."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Mutshavhi? Nga 25% ya Sovereign Pearl Holdings kha vault ya Dubai, vha ḓo mmbita mufhati wa vhuleme ha tsireledzo ya matshavha-tshavha! Bva nḓilani ya nosewheel, kana u ite vhuṱambo hau ha u fhedzisela fhano!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Unit 3 na Unit 5 dzi khou ya ngafhi?! U a nkhakhisa, Sbu—wo shandukisa masergenti anga vha lwa na nne! Muṅwe na muṅwe a ḓi-vhonele kha tarmac!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Tarmac yo vhulea. A ri fhedzeni hezwi."
