tutorial.step1.title: Step 1: Daily Action Dice & Mulalo wa Mbilu
tutorial.step1.desc: At dawn each Muvhuso wa Tshifhinga (Day), your investigator rolls a pool of 3 to 5 six-sided dice based on current Mulalo wa Mbilu (80–100% = 5 dice, 40–79% = 4 dice, <40% = 3 dice). Mulalo wa Mbilu is your mental stamina and resilience against Durban's underworld.
tutorial.step2.title: Step 2: Assigning Dice to Action Slots
tutorial.step2.desc: Hold or click a die from your bottom dock, then click an Action Slot on any unlocked map node. Rolls resolve deterministically: Die Value + Stat Modifier + Stage 6 U Dzima ha Mudagasi Modifier + Hostile Turf Penalty. Tiers preview cleanly: 6+ Kuna U Bvelela, 4–5 Compromised, 1–3 U Kundelwa.
tutorial.step3.title: Step 3: Rolling Blackouts (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.desc: Eskom power rotates across Stages 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 each night. During Stage 6 Blackouts, high-tech server slots lock down unless you spend R300 on Backup Generator Diesel, but covert operations at the Port and Estates gain a +2 Roll Bonus under cover of darkness.
tutorial.step4.title: Step 4: Threat & Investigation Clocks
tutorial.step4.desc: Circular segmented clocks tick down impending catastrophes (Brigadier Mokoena's Mushumo wa u Kulumaga, Nandi's Mbonzhe, Izinkabi Hit Squads) and track your forensic breakthroughs (Dokhethi #409 U Sedzuluswa ha Masheleni, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). When investigation clocks fill, climactic finale showdowns unlock.
tutorial.step5.title: Step 5: Roadblocks & Faction Perks
tutorial.step5.desc: High Tshititshi tsha Mapholisa Heat or Threat levels trigger armed SAPS roadblock corridors between sectors. Crossing them burns 1 Die or R200 in cold drink bribes unless you possess a cloned SAPS scanner. Earn positive Faction Rep to unlock 1/day tactical abilities like Grid Manipulation and Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step6.title: Step 6: Contacts, Evidence & Red-String Board
tutorial.step6.desc: Speak with local fixers and faction bosses at each node to interrogate leads, present forensic exhibits, and claim one-time favors. Press 'B' or tap 'BOARD' anytime to inspect your red-string conspiracy corkboard, tracing the money trail from City Hall to Berth 14.

ending.ending_vigilante.pathLabel: THE Mulweli wa Mulayo PATH // BLOOD ON THE BREAKWATER
ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Vhuimela-Zwikepe floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Mali yo Dzudzanywaho, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.title: Abasanta Tshigwada tsha Vhugevhenga Crippled
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.summary: R80 million in Mexican chemical precursors burn on the quay. Zuko Ndlovu retreats to his inland citrus estates, vowing to purge the port security directorate.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.title: Queen Street Ascendant
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.summary: Bra Bheki’s Tshumisano ya Vhugevhenga seizes control of the Umgeni transport corridor, forcing City Hall to pay his 30% forum cut on every tanker truck.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.title: The Ghost of Mercury Arcade
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.summary: With R450,000 in stolen Tshigwada tsha Vhugevhenga Mali yo Dzudzanywaho funding your off-grid clinic and armoury, you become the CBD’s untouchable shadow fixer.
ending.ending_whistleblower.pathLabel: THE Mubviseli-Nnda PATH // TRUTH IN THE DARK
ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Fhethu ha Zwitoko Kamara ya Fhasi. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.title: City Hall in Freefall
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.summa: National Treasury freezes the R400m water-tanker contract by noon. Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff is arrested at King Shaka International Airport trying to board a flight to Dubai.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.title: SAPS Internal Purge
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.summa: IPID and the Hawks raid Central Tshititshi tsha Mapholisa’s 13th Floor. Brigadier Mokoena goes underground with a rogue detachment of loyal TRT officers.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.title: Badge Restored, Target Painted
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.summa: Colonel van der Merwe reinstates your Warrant Officer credentials—but Abasanta’s Chemical Ghost hitmen have just placed a R5 million bounty on your badge.
ending.ending_kingpin.pathLabel: THE KINGPIN PATH // THE GLASS HOUSE COMPACT
ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Dokhethi #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.title: The Tshumisano ya Vhugevhenga Consolidates
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.summary: The Berth 14 precursor shipment rolls through the N2 weighbridge untouched under blue-light escort. The methamphetamine super-labs double their output.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.title: Hawks Task Force Shuttered
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.summary: Without Dokhethi #409, Colonel van der Merwe’s inquiry collapses for lack of evidence. His Kamara ya Fhasi unit is reassigned to rural stock-theft duty.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.title: The New Fixer-General
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.summary: You move out of the Mercury Arcade flat into a Ridge penthouse—wealthy, reinstated, and permanently chained to Zuko Ndlovu’s Bugu ya Masheleni.
ending.ending_captured.pathLabel: SYSTEMIC U Kundelwa // SWALLOWED BY THE GRID
ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Dokhethi #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Kuna, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.
ending.ending_captured.shift1.title: State Capture Unchecked
ending.ending_captured.shift1.summary: Ma-Sibi wins the municipal coalition vote unopposed, expanding the emergency water-tanker contracts by another R600 million.
ending.ending_captured.shift2.title: Dokhethi #409 Erased
ending.ending_captured.shift2.summary: The N2 Mali yo Dzudzanywaho-in-Transit massacre is officially closed as an unsolved Tshumisano ya Vhugevhenga hijacking.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.pathLabel: ACT 2 FINALE // THE CONSTITUTIONAL U Haṱulwa ha Mafhungo
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Tshititshi tsha Mapholisa.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Tshumisano ya Vhugevhenga’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Tshigwada tsha Vhugevhenga protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Dokhethi pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Vhuimela-Zwikepe cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.pathLabel: ACT 2 U Kundelwa // REDACTED FROM THE RECORD
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Bugu ya Masheleni and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.title: Kuna Getaway
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.summa: Zuko Ndlovu and Ma-Sibi relocate their logistics empire to Dubai while retaining silent proxies inside City Hall.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.title: Case Closed
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.summa: Without the Sovereign Pearl deed or Midlands telemetry, the High Court dismisses all remaining charges.

mission.faq_q1_title: 1. "Cycle" ndi mini nahone hu na nngana?
mission.faq_q1_body: Cycle ndi Ḓuvha ḽithihi kha Mutshino (tshifhinga tsha awara dza 24). A hu na tshivhalo tsho randelwaho tsha maḓuvha a 50 kana 100. Nṱhani hazwo, ni khou gidima u lwisana na Tshirolosi tsha Zwitsireledzi tshi Bvelaho phanḓa (sa tsha Brigadier Mokoena kha zwipida zwa 6). Thodisiso yo ḓoweleaho i dzhia dicycle dza 3 u swika 6 kha Act 1 na dza 4 u swika 8 kha Act 2.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ndi wana ḓayisi nngana? Naa ndi posa ḓayisi kha fhethu hoṱhe?
mission.faq_q2_body: Mutsheloni muṅwe na muṅwe, ni posa ḓayisi dza 3 u swika 5 TSHOṰHE ḓoroboni yoṱhe hu tshi tevhedzwa Vhudikumedzi havho (80%+ = ḓayisi dza 5, 40–79% = ḓayisi dza 4, <40% = ḓayisi dza 3). A NI posi ḓayisi kha fhethu hoṱhe! Ni nanga nyito dza nkoka dza 3 u swika 5 kha maapu u shela nungo dza ḓuvha ḽoṱhe.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Hu itea mini musi ndi tshi kanda "Fhedza Cycle / Lala"?
mission.faq_q3_body:
U kanda Fhedza Cycle zwi fhedza tshifhinga tshavho zwa ya matsheloni a tevhelaho:
• Tshirolosi tsha Zwitsireledzi tshi a bvela phanḓa (+1 tshipida kha tshirolosi tshitshuku).
• U dzima mudagasi zwi a mona (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Mulaedza wo Dzumbamaho wa Matsheloni u a swika u na mafhungo maswa a tshiitea.
• Ni posa ḓayisi ntswa matshelo nga matsheloni.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ndi ḓivha hani uri ndi ḓayisi dzifhio dzo shumiswaho na dzo salaho?
mission.faq_q4_body: Thirei ya fhasi i sumbedza "X Zwi hone • Y Zwo shumiswaho". Ḓayisi dzo shumiswaho dzi vha dza muvhala mutswu dza vha na tag ya [ZWO SHUMISWAHO]. Ḓayisi dzo salaho dzi penya nga nomboro dza musuku.
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. Naa mutambi wanga a nga fa kana a bveledza Game Over?
mission.faq_q5_body: Ee! Arali u tsireledza ha Brigadier Mokoena ha swika 6/6, fulatsha yavho i a phusukanywa ha fhelela nga u farwa. Arali u bva malofha ha Constable Nandi ha vha 4/4 ni sa athu u mu khwaṱhisa, u fa tshoṱhe fulatshani yavho (-30% Vhudikumedzi). Arali Vhudikumedzi havho ha swika 0%, ni thoma Blackout Paranoia!

intro.pitch_story4: Mbofho ya tshiphiri ya dzigenerala dza mapholisa a vundu, zwigwada zwo ṱanganelanaho zwa zwigevhenga zwa Cape Flats, na vho-ramabindu vha divhalesaho vha Winelands vhane vha khou ṱhoma mmbi ya tsireledzo ya phuraivethe u langa ikonomi ya vhusiku na vhuimamalavhu ha u rumela nnda. Muṱoli wa kale wa Yuniti ya u Lwa na Zwigwada Leila Hendricks u sedzulusa u bva Camps Bay u swika zwititshini zwa waini zwa Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: U Dzima ho Fhelelaho ha Netiweke ya Mudagasi ha Tshiteji tsha 8 kha mavundu oṱhe a ṱahe. Tshumisano ya Hawks i ṱanganya matombo mana a ndeme a dzingu a mufhedziso u dzhia muṱangano muhulwane wa Sovereign Octagon Drakensberg themokhirasi i sa athu fheliswa tshoṱhe.
